name: CheXpert: A Large Chest Radiograph Dataset
description: A large chest radiograph benchmark dataset comprising 224,316 chest radiographs from 65,240 patients collected from Stanford Hospital between October 2002 and July 2017. Radiographs were labeled for the presence of 14 common chest observations using an automated rule-based labeler that extracts labels from free-text radiology reports with explicit uncertainty handling. Safeguard notice: Intended exclusively for research and algorithm development; not approved as a medical device for direct clinical patient diagnosis or care.
